encounters.name: The Lamplighter's Debt
encounters.desc: The drowned are holding the old lamplighter in the middle of the court. He doesn't fight. Kill everything else; anything that hits every enemy hits him too.
encounters.intro: He owes them. Oil. Light. Something. They've come to. Collect.

encounters.name: Steve's Last Table

triggers.label: The tide comes back for him

encounters.desc: Islands, rising water, and they move first. Heralds burst; mudlarks hook stragglers. Steve was standing about where you are.
encounters.intro: This is. Where Steve. Stood. Stand. There. Yes. Exactly.

encounters.name: The Seawall
encounters.desc: Two bulwarks hold the wall and a priest keeps them patched. Blades bounce; fire and lightning find the cracks. Kill the priest or you'll be here all night.
encounters.intro: The wall. Holds. The wall has always. Held. Mostly.

encounters.name: The Novice in the Nave
encounters.desc: The penitents have a novice tied to a pillar, to be saved. The novice doesn't fight. Kill the congregation without killing the novice; area cards will.
encounters.intro: They're going. To save her. Save. Save her. Whether she. Likes it.

encounters.name: Two Altars and a Surgeon
encounters.desc: Two altars heal the congregation every turn and the surgeon stitches up the rest. Smash the altars fast and the fight is yours.
encounters.intro: Two altars. One surgeon. No. Waiting list.

encounters.name: The Reliquary Procession
encounters.desc: The reliquary is carried in procession: a veteran flagellant in front, a collector behind to take your cards. It grows worse every turn nobody hurts it.
encounters.intro: The saints. On parade. They are carried. By the people. They ate.

encounters.name: Payday
encounters.desc: The wages are in the safe and the machines want them. Mites burst. More arrive in rounds 2 and 3.
encounters.intro: Payday. Gary. Never. Got paid. Did he.

encounters.name: The Signal Box
encounters.desc: Two signal pylons keep the yard live. Smash them while the tinker rewires and the gunner covers. Shock rails split the yard.
encounters.intro: The 9:14. Is. Running. Late. Someone. Has to. Change. The signal.

encounters.name: The Deputy's Posse
encounters.desc: The iron deputy, a gunner and two mites that run at you and burst. Spread out, or don't.
encounters.intro: Dead. Or. Dead. The poster. Was very. Clear.

encounters.name: Seat Four's Miniature
encounters.desc: The prompter stands in the middle holding Steve's script. It doesn't fight. Kill the greys without breaking it.
encounters.intro: Steve's. Script. Don't. Drop it. He's. He's still. Reading.

encounters.name: The Rules Committee
encounters.desc: The chair of the committee is the elite rules lawyer. Cut him down early and the knights lose their paperwork.
encounters.intro: The committee. Has met. You. Are. Overruled.

encounters.name: Doubles
encounters.desc: The understudy plays your parts better than you do, a loaded die rolls itself at you, and the wraith rubs out the floor.
encounters.intro: Doubles. Doubles. Roll. Again. Steve rolled. Doubles. Once.
